name: Coefficient Space of the Two-Control Graph Construction
parameters: $m=|V(G)|$, $e=|E(G)|$, $N=\binom m2-e$, $d=2m+N+4e$, and $\Omega(G)=\{z\in\mathbb R^V:z_v<z_w\text{ for every arc }v\to w\}$.
scope: Homeomorphism of the full positive normalized separator coefficient space, including all row ratios.
proof: Each vertex row contributes the ratio $t_v=a_{p_v,0}/a_{p_v,1}$ and one free ratio. An edge witness forces and, by the explicit construction, is forced by $t_v<t_w$ on every arc. Nonedge rows contribute one free ratio and the two rows of each edge contribute four. Taking $z_v=\log t_v$ gives the displayed order cone and product.
